title: Write evergreen notes
principle: Prefer concept-oriented notes that are atomically clear, densely linked, and refined over time—not dated daily dump files.
procedure: One idea per note; split when a note smuggles two.
Link aggressively to related concepts; write the link context.
Revise notes when understanding improves; don’t freeze first drafts.
Prefer associational navigation over chronological logs for ideas.
examplePrompts:
Convert these raw notes into evergreen notes.

Rules: concept titles; atomic; contextual links; revise language for clarity.
Reject date-titled dumps.
Output 5 evergreen note outlines with links between them.
tips: Andy’s public notes define evergreen note practice.
